description: This source file contains a set of unit tests for the Orleans framework, focusing on the 'ElasticPlacement' strategy which dynamically adjusts grain placement across silos based on load and silo state. It includes test setup, configuration, and various test cases such as catching up, stopping silos, high CPU load, and overload scenarios, along with helper methods for managing grains and silos.

classes.name: ElasticPlacementTests
classes.description: A class containing unit tests to verify the behavior of the elastic grain placement strategy in Orleans, including handling of silo load balancing, silos stopping, and overload scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster by adding silo configurator for memory storage and load shedding options.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_CatchingUp
methods.description: Tests the placement strategy's ability to favor new silos until load balance is achieved.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_StoppingSilos
methods.description: Verifies that the placement strategy redistributes load evenly when silos are stopped.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosCPUTooHigh
methods.description: Ensures no new activation is placed when all silos have high CPU utilization.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosOverloaded
methods.description: Checks the behavior when all silos are overloaded or report high load, expecting exceptions.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnOverloadedSilo
methods.description: Verifies load-aware placement prevents activation on silos marked as overloaded.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnBusySilos
methods.description: Verifies load-aware placement prevents activation on silos with high CPU usage.

methods.name: GetGrainAtSilo
methods.description: Retrieves a test grain located on a specific silo, retrying until successful.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that the actual activation count falls within the expected range considering load leeway.

methods.name: ElasticityGrainPlacementTest
methods.description: Conducts a test to ensure load is redistributed away from a tainted silo and grains are not placed there.

methods.name: AddTestGrains
methods.description: Activates a number of test grains for load testing.

methods.name: InvokeAllGrains
methods.description: Activates all test grains to simulate load.

methods.name: GetPerSiloActivationCounts
methods.description: Fetches current activation counts per silo for verification.

methods.name: LogCounts
methods.description: Logs the activation count for each silo.
